SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT A.BUYER, A.LEGACY_IV_SERIAL, A.INV_NO, '0' AS PROCESS_TYPE FROM ICOMIVHD A WHERE A.BUYER IN ('KRHYOS0033','KRHYOS0034','KRHYOS0036','KRHYOS0037','KRHYOS0043') AND trim(A.LEGACY_IV_SERIAL) IS NOT NULL AND A.INV_TYPE = '0' AND A.SND_CHK = 'N' UNION SELECT B.BUYER, B.LEGACY_IV_SERIAL, B.INV_NO, '2' AS PROCESS_TYPE FROM WMSIVDT B WHERE B.BUYER IN ('KRHYOS0033','KRHYOS0034','KRHYOS0036','KRHYOS0037','KRHYOS0043') AND B.LEGACY_IV_SERIAL IS NOT NULL AND B.SND_CHK = 'N' GROUP BY B.BUYER, B.LEGACY_IV_SERIAL, B.INV_NO ORDER BY BUYER, LEGACY_IV_SERIAL, INV_NO
